 A Message From Dr. XBOX: It’s Time to Take the Day Off and Play XBOX
 DJ Khaled, aka Dr.XBOX 
 November 16, 2026 · 2 min read 
 Some may know me as DJ Khaled. Some may know me as a hitmaker, a major key provider. But today, I want you to call me Dr. XBOX.
 Why? Because I’ve been seeing something out there. And the symptoms? They are REAL.
 I’m talking twitchy thumbs. Controller cramps. Late-night gaming dreams. Uncontrollable excitement every time a new game drops. And don’t even get me started on release-date restlessness. MAJOR.
 After extensive research (and a whole lot of gaming), I’ve come to one conclusion: there’s a serious case of Vitamin G deficiency around the world. And I’m here to tell you that the cure is simple.
 Take. The. Day. Off.
 That’s right. A BIG week in gaming is coming, and I don’t want anybody missing a single moment. We’ve got games to play, worlds to explore, achievements to unlock and victories to celebrate. This is not the week to be distracted by emails, meetings or somebody asking you to do something that isn’t gaming.
 You have to prioritize YOU. And by YOU, I mean your XBOX.
 Now, I know what you’re thinking. “Dr. XBOX, how can I possibly get the day off?” Don’t worry. I’ve got the MAJOR KEY.
 I’m officially prescribing a day dedicated to doing what you love: staying home, picking up that controller and playing XBOX. No distractions. No interruptions. Just you, your favorite games and the freedom to experience the biggest week in gaming the way it was meant to be experienced.
 And because I believe in taking care of my people, I’ve made it official.
 Head over to DrXBOX.com to get your very own personalized doctor’s note, from the sunny shores of tropical Miami.
 That’s right. Your very own prescription for more gaming. Put it on your fridge. Show your boss. Send it to your group chat. Let the people know that Dr. XBOX has spoken.
 Now, before anybody asks, is this doctor’s note* medically certified?
 Let’s be clear. My degree from XBOX University may be unofficial, my medical credentials may be questionable, but one thing is undeniable: gaming is MAJOR.
 The diagnosis is in. The prescription is written. The only thing left to do is take the day off.
 ANOTHER ONE!
 *Doctor’s note is not real. XBOX is not responsible if your employer doesn’t have a sense of humor. Please game responsibly.
